title: Texas NHRA FallNationals puts bow on Texas Motorplex's 10-day festival this weekend - NewsBreak
text:
By SportsDay Staff ,
10 hours ago BRISTOL, TN - JUNE 08: Shawn Langdon, of Danville, IN, Kaliita Air / Toyota '24 Kalitta during first round qualifying for the NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals on Saturday June 8, 2024 at the Bristol Dragway in Bristol, Tennessee. (Photo by David J. Griffin/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) (Icon Sportswire/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) Texas Motorplex's Stampede of Speed culminates with the 41st Texas NHRA FallNationals this weekend in Ennis.
As always, the event's placement on the NHRA calendar guarantees the action will play a huge role in crowning world champions next month when the series wraps up in Pomona, Calif.
Pro stock and pro stock motorcycle qualifying session 1 kicks off the main event Friday at 4:15 p.m., with a second session in these classes set for 7 p.m. Greg Stanfield carries a 71-point lead in pro stock over Dallas Glenn into the fourth of sixth playoff events, with Matt Hartford just 10 points further back. Meanwhile, Richard Gadson's advantage in pro stock motorcycle is just 32 points over Gaige Herrera.
The first session of Nitro qualifying will begin at 5:15 p.m. Friday, with round 2 wrapping up the night's activities at 8 p.m. Funny car star Matt Hagan, a three-time winner and six-time runner-up in Ennis, carries a 72-point edge over Jordan Vandergriff into the event. Shawn Langdon, in top fuel, holds the largest lead among the NHRA's national series with a 116-point lead over Doug Kalitta.
Qualifying will continue Saturday with pro stock sessions at 1 p.m. and 3:30 p.m. and Nitro sessions at noon and 2:30 p.m. Final eliminations will start at noon Sunday.
For more information, visit stampedeforspeed.com .
